title: Evaluating GPT-3.5's Awareness and Summarization Abilities for European Constitutional Texts with Shared Topics
findings: The study found that GPT-3.5 has an adequate level of knowledge about European constitutional topics related to citizens' rights, including freedom of religion and equality regardless of creed. It was also capable of generating informative, coherent, and faithful summaries of these legal texts.
